text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that fails the core inclusion criteria. Its primary focus is on simulating the co-evolution of the energy-water-land system under carbon neutrality and climate impacts using an integrated assessment model (GCAM). While it does involve future land use projections as *one component* of the system, the central research question is not LULC prediction. The LULC changes are outputs of the broader economic and resource model, not the result of a dedicated LULC prediction/simulation model. The study uses downscaling tools (Demeter) to spatially allocate regional land use results, but this is not the paper's primary methodological focus. The core objective is policy and impact analysis of the energy-water-land nexus, not the prediction of LULC patterns themselves.)
